skills.name: Ordinary and extraordinary activities; parallelism of accounts

vars.x: a shop sells its old delivery van

worked_example.problem: Is it an ordinary or an extraordinary activity when {x}? In which class is it recorded?
steps: The shop's normal business is buying and selling goods, not vans.
Selling a fixed asset is unusual: an extraordinary (HAO) activity.

cards.idea: Ordinary activities are the normal, regular operations; they go in classes {6} and {7}.
Extraordinary (HAO) activities are unusual events; they go in class {8}.
Parallelism: expense and income accounts match, for example {60} Purchases and {70} Sales.

w: 82 Proceeds from sale of fixed assets

pick.e: 81 Book value of fixed assets sold
pick.r: 82 Proceeds from sale of fixed assets

check.prompt: By parallelism, which income account matches expense account {X.e}?

misconceptions.explain: Match the number pattern: the expense in 6x matches the income in 7x, and 81 matches 82, 83 matches 84.

solution: Expense and income accounts are numbered to match each other.

pick.f: Paying a fine to the tax office.

questions.prompt: Is this an ordinary or an extraordinary activity for a shop? {X.f}

distractors.text: not an activity of the business

misconceptions.explain: Ask: does this happen regularly in the normal business?
It is an activity of the business.

solution: Ordinary activities are the normal, regular operations; extraordinary ones are unusual.

pick.q: In which class are extraordinary (HAO) activities recorded?

w: 82 Proceeds from sale of fixed assets

pick.e: 81 Book value of fixed assets sold
pick.r: 82 Proceeds from sale of fixed assets

questions.prompt: By parallelism, which income account matches expense account {X.e}?

misconceptions.explain: Match the number pattern: the expense in 6x matches the income in 7x, and 81 matches 82, 83 matches 84.

solution: Expense and income accounts are numbered to match each other.

right.text: Selling goods is an ordinary activity.
Selling an old van is extraordinary.

wrong.text: Paying monthly salaries is an extraordinary activity.
A loss from a flood is recorded in class 7.
